decisions.reason: The source changes the separate hover-label text and purpose; it does not change whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The label must remain available as hover help after field text is replaced, but this does not alter the editable-field mechanism or legacy-field handling.
The source defines interactive-field help-label content, not the required style set or its coverage across templates.
Replacing text inside a control field and hovering its label does not affect manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The source concerns form-field help labels and does not change graphic bullet appearance or level variants.
The field-label clarification does not modify the task-local assessment steps, budget, coverage, or outputs.
Although interactive-field labels and theme colors were previously mentioned together, the source changes only label content and hover purpose.
The source does not address copying content between legacy and new templates or the resulting formatting workflow.
The field-label behavior does not change Tab-controlled list levels, hierarchy, or alignment.
The source does not affect table structures, page margins, columns, or table behavior during paste.
The source uses label to mean hover help for an interactive field, not image/table caption typography or heading/title formatting.
The field-label clarification does not change the contents or delivery condition of the updated template package.
